name: Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI)
description: Indonesian Child Protection Commission: receives complaints about violations of children's rights, assesses them, refers children to service providers (UPTD PPA, Dinas Sosial, police) and oversees how agencies follow up.
description_id: Komisi Perlindungan Anak Indonesia: menerima pengaduan pelanggaran hak anak, menelaahnya, merujuk anak ke penyedia layanan (UPTD PPA, Dinas Sosial, kepolisian), dan mengawasi tindak lanjut instansi.

categories.label: Physical or psychological violence against a child (incl. bullying with injury)
categories.label_id: Kekerasan fisik atau psikis terhadap anak (termasuk perundungan yang melukai)

categories.label: Children in conflict with the law (ABH), as offender, victim or witness
categories.label_id: Anak berhadapan dengan hukum (ABH), sebagai pelaku, korban, atau saksi

categories.label: Child trafficking, child labour and economic or sexual exploitation
categories.label_id: Perdagangan anak, pekerja anak, serta eksploitasi ekonomi atau seksual

categories.label: Pornography and cybercrime (grooming, sextortion, abuse images, online bullying)
categories.label_id: Pornografi dan kejahatan siber (grooming, pemerasan seksual, konten kekerasan seksual, perundungan daring)

categories.label: Family and alternative care (custody disputes, child support, access, adoption, neglect)
categories.label_id: Keluarga dan pengasuhan alternatif (hak asuh, nafkah anak, akses bertemu, adopsi, penelantaran)

categories.label: Education, leisure, culture and religion (school bullying, fees, right to school)
categories.label_id: Pendidikan, waktu luang, budaya, dan agama (perundungan di sekolah, biaya, hak bersekolah)

categories.label: Basic health and welfare (health services, nutrition, free school meals)
categories.label_id: Kesehatan dasar dan kesejahteraan (layanan kesehatan, gizi, makan bergizi di sekolah)

categories.label: Civil rights and other (birth certificate, identity, participation, other)
categories.label_id: Hak sipil dan lainnya (akta kelahiran, identitas, partisipasi, lainnya)

queues.pka_violence: Special Protection: violence, sexual crimes and children in conflict with the law
queues.pka_exploitation: Special Protection: trafficking, exploitation, pornography and cybercrime

procedures.title: KPAI complaint, from report to closing
procedures.title_id: Pengaduan KPAI, dari laporan sampai selesai
requirements: The child's identity (birth certificate or family card)
procedures.note: If the data is incomplete an officer contacts you within 3 x 24 hours; if it is complete you hear back within 14 working days.
procedures.note_id: Jika data belum lengkap, petugas menghubungi Anda dalam 3 x 24 jam; jika lengkap, Anda mendapat jawaban dalam 14 hari kerja.

stages.title: Checked: is it a child protection case?
Referral to a service (SAPA 129, UPTD PPA, Dinas Sosial, police), or oversight of the agency that handled it
stages.title_id: Rujukan ke layanan (SAPA 129, UPTD PPA, Dinas Sosial, kepolisian), atau pengawasan atas lembaga yang menangani

stages.title: Clarification and mediation if needed; recommendation issued
stages.title_id: Klarifikasi dan mediasi jika perlu; rekomendasi diterbitkan

stages.title: Monitoring how the recommendation is followed up
Case closed with the complainant (or if unreachable 3 times in 3 weeks)
stages.title_id: Kasus ditutup bersama pengadu (atau jika tidak dapat dihubungi 3 kali dalam 3 minggu)
